original_ai_output.title_zh: 吉布提海域船只倾覆致109人死亡，其中包括儿童
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据国际移民组织称，一艘从吉布提驶往也门的船只周四晚在奥博克港镇附近倾覆，船上载有350人，至少109名移民死亡，其中包括15名儿童，另有数十人失踪，约80人获救。国际移民组织表示，死者中包括52名男性、42名女性、9名女孩和6名男孩。该机构称，2025年已有900多名移民在同一路线上死亡或失踪。

location.raw_text: near the port town of Obock

key_facts.fact: 一艘从吉布提驶往也门的船只倾覆，船上载有350人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The boat was travelling from Djibouti to Yemen with 350 people on board, when it capsized near the port town of Obock on Thursday night.

key_facts.fact: 至少109名移民死亡，其中包括15名儿童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least 109 migrants including 15 children have died and dozens more are still missing after a boat sank off the coast of Djibouti, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) has said.
Around 80 people were rescued, the IOM said.

key_facts.fact: 死者中包括52名男性、42名女性、9名女孩和6名男孩
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the organisation said 52 men, 42 women, nine girls and six boys were among the bodies recovered.

key_facts.fact: 2025年已有900多名移民在同一路线上死亡或失踪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: more than 900 migrants died or went missing taking the same route in 2025, with an 18% increase in the number of people attempting the journey.

uncertainties: 仍有数十人失踪，具体人数尚未确认
